title: F1 alt: BERLINCLOCK / EASTNORTHEAST compound keywords as single sub keys
hypothesis_summary: Alternative reading of the disclosed-crib evidence. Where F1-11/12 try BERLIN+CLOCK and EAST+NORTHEAST as TWO independent keyword candidates, this pack tests the compound forms BERLINCLOCK and EASTNORTHEAST as SINGLE substitution keys. The compounds appear in the public clue registry's core public-cribs tier as the full disclosed spans. This pack falsifies (or supports) the split-vs-compound role distinction.

provenance_items.quote_or_summary: BERLINCLOCK and EASTNORTHEAST registered as TIER_CORE_PUBLIC_CRIBS compound entries.

composition_templates.rationale: Compound keywords as both sub and columnar role across the i3 emitter.
Beaufort form of the same role pairing.

constraints: Allowed keyword pool restricted to compound disclosed spans only.
caveats: ALTERNATIVE-MECHANISM framing relative to F1-11/12 (split keywords) and F1-13 (KRYPTOS-only floor).
Long compound keywords reduce the substitution period to a single repeat over 11-13 of 97 positions; this is a structural commitment of this pack.
